'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Ryan French DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan French]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan French]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Let Them Make The First Move]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
